s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive systemic illness with generalized weakness, weight loss, and multi-organ involvement
key_facts: Six months of progressive generalized weakness
Noncompliant with lisinopril for over three years
Dullness to percussion and decreased breath sounds at the left lung base
Blood urea nitrogen 60 mg/dL, creatinine 1.69 mg/dL
Chest radiography showed bilateral pleural effusions
High titers of ANA, anti–double-stranded DNA, and anti–Smith antibodies
Urinalysis showed pH 5, 16 WBCs and 27 RBCs per high-power field

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive systemic illness with generalized weakness, weight loss, and multi-organ involvement
key_facts: Six months of progressive generalized weakness
Noncompliant with lisinopril for over three years
Dullness to percussion and decreased breath sounds at the left lung base
Blood urea nitrogen 60 mg/dL, creatinine 1.69 mg/dL
Chest radiography showed bilateral pleural effusions
High titers of ANA, anti–double-stranded DNA, and anti–Smith antibodies
Urinalysis showed pH 5, 16 WBCs and 27 RBCs per high-power field

differentials: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis secondary to autoimmune disease
per_call: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis secondary to autoimmune disease

shortlist.label: Systemic lupus erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: High titers of ANA, anti–double-stranded DNA, and anti–Smith antibodies, with low complement C3 levels, and multi-organ involvement

shortlist.label: Sjögren's syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Mucosal pallor, non-tender lymphadenopathy, and potential renal involvement

shortlist.label: Rheumatoid arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: Acute inflammatory arthritis of the elbows and knees, although less likely given other systemic features

shortlist.label: Wegener's granulomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Renal involvement and potential pulmonary involvement, although less likely given lack of granulomatous findings

shortlist.label: Castleman disease
shortlist.why_kept: Lymphadenopathy and multi-organ involvement, although less common and would require further evaluation

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with progressive generalized weakness, weight loss, dyspnea, mucosal pallor, lymphadenopathy, and bilateral pleural effusions, along with laboratory findings of anemia, leukopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers, is consistent with a systemic autoimmune disease. The presence of high titers of ANA, anti-double-stranded DNA, and anti-Smith antibodies, along with low complement C3 levels, strongly supports the diagnosis of systemic lupus erythematosus.

rejected.label: Sjögren's syndrome
rejected.why: Lack of symptoms such as dry eyes and dry mouth, which are typical of Sjögren's syndrome

rejected.label: Rheumatoid arthritis
rejected.why: Absence of joint deformities and morning stiffness, which are characteristic of rheumatoid arthritis

rejected.label: Wegener's granulomatosis
rejected.why: No evidence of granulomatous inflammation or vasculitis on biopsy

rejected.label: Castleman disease
rejected.why: Lack of characteristic lymph node histology and absence of other typical features such as fever and night sweats
